intro: ICRI Delhi and ILAM both sit in Noida, and this page compares their recorded BBA / BBM / BBS fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.
ICRI Delhi vs ILAM is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: ICRI Delhi vs ILAM for BBA / BBM / BBS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ICRI Delhi if its BBA / BBM / BBS programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose ILAM if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
ICRI Delhi lists BBA Aviation Management, BBA Logistics & Supply Chain  Management. ILAM lists BBA Aviation Management, BBA Logistics & Supply Chain  Management, BBA Public Policy.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹41,667 a year as total fees for ICRI Delhi's BBA Logistics & Supply Chain  Management. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records do not hold a quotable BBA / BBM / BBS programme fee for ILAM on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, ICRI Delhi's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for BBA Aviation Management. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for ILAM on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for ICRI Delhi on this BBA / BBM / BBS page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for ILAM on this BBA / BBM / BBS page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Noida, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in ICRI Delhi vs ILAM for BBA / BBM / BBS. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
